Appraiser remarks
The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the driver-side headlamp assembly is broken. The radiator
support shows bending consistent with a frontal load, and the hood latch area has a shallow crease. Most of this
damage lines up well with the impact as described. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, headlamp
assembly, and hood, with a frame check and refinishing of the affected panels. Labor hours are slightly above what
this damage typically needs, so the shop should justify the extra time. The billing records show no repeated charges,
and there is no known prior damage to this vehicle.
